title: 目標達成の後に・オグリン！？

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I take Oguri Cap out for dinner as a reward for her continual success in the G1 races.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: …Gulp. Hey, could I get another burger?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Didn't you say I could go ahead and fill my belly?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Actually, I'd best not. Instead…

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I'll round things off with some salad. Do you mind if I get ten corn salads?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wanting to reward her for her repeated success in the G1 races, I nod and try to forget about my poor wallet.

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: Hey, look! Isn't that Ogurin?

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text: Oh my gosh, you're right! Oguriiin!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: …Ogurin?

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text: Whoa! She looked at us! She's so cool!

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text: We're big fans of yours, Ogurin! Good luck in your next race!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: O-oh… Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Recently, Oguri Cap has been topping all the popularity charts—even here in the city. I guess that's what happens when you compete in enough races.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yeah… It makes me happy knowing people are in my corner.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I hope I have their support in the next race as well.
choice_data_list: That'll be the autumn Tenno Sho, right?
That'll be the autumn Tenno Sho, right?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yep. Tama's been waiting for this challenge, so I need to keep upping my game.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: …It's like a fire has lit inside my belly.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: After I'm done with these salads, I'm going to order fifty large burgers!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her sparkling eyes are shining so bright right now, it's almost blinding.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: …Wait, what? You mean this place isn't all-you-can-eat?!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I-I'm so sorry… I thought this was some sort of buffet…

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: …Hey! Are you okay?! Wake up!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With that, celebrations for Oguri Cap's G1 race wins come to an end.
